item.text: The parser currently turns any source RPM parse error into a fatal line error. I’ll change that path to record a warning and still return the binary package, and adjust filename splitting so an epoch prefix moves from the parsed name into the version. I’ll apply the same warning behavior to the repoquery variant, which uses the same source filename parser.

The code change now preserves binary package metadata when `SOURCERPM` cannot be split, while storing the parse error in the scanner’s warning list. Epochs found in source filenames are carried into the source version without duplicating the binary line’s epoch. The scanner tests are still compiling/running.

The test command has produced no output for over a minute, so it may be waiting on dependency setup. I’ll stop that run and retry with module downloads disabled, keeping verification local as required.
